route_superseded_by.note: R4B recommended the market-cap route partly because the A/H split was missing; the A-share per-share convention (ADR-002) makes the A/H split non-blocking for the 'A-share price ÷ company-wide per-share fundamental' convention. The historical UNRESOLVED/MARKET_CAP judgement is preserved here, not erased.

rationale.reason: Historical PE/PB/PS PIT valuation is not implementable from committed data: quarterly net profit (PE-TTM), quarterly revenue (PS-TTM), quarterly equity granularity (PB-MRQ), a canonical total-ordinary-share timeline with effective dates and corporate actions, and a weighted-average share history are absent. The current financial facts are annual-only. Per ADR-VALUATION-002 the A/H split is NOT a core-valuation blocker; the blocker is the quarterly financial facts and the share timeline.
